title: 荷兰政府基于NixOS构建微软替代方案
summary: 荷兰政府正在基于NixOS构建一个替代微软产品的方案，旨在减少对专有软件的依赖并增强数字主权。该项目名为DAWO（Digital Autonomy With Open source），其网站dawo.community提供了更多信息。在Hacker News上，该话题获得了376个点赞和165条评论，引发了关于政府采用开源技术、数字自主权以及NixOS作为基础平台可行性的广泛讨论。此举可能推动公共部门采用开源解决方案，并影响其他国家的类似决策。
summary_en: The Dutch government is building an alternative to Microsoft based on NixOS, aiming to reduce reliance on proprietary software and enhance digital sovereignty. The project, called DAWO (Digital Autonomy With Open source), has more information available at dawo.community. On Hacker News, the topic received 376 points and 165 comments, sparking widespread discussion about government adoption of open-source technology, digital autonomy, and the feasibility of NixOS as a foundational platform. This move could promote open-source solutions in the public sector and influence similar decisions in other countries.
